timeline.labelEn: Vines reported in the Elbe valley when Henry I's troops entered the Nisan district (Thietmar of Merseburg)
timeline.labelDe: Weinstöcke im Elbtal beim Einfall der Truppen Heinrichs I. in den Gau Nisan (Thietmar von Merseburg)

questions.notes: Wikipedia calls Sachsen the easternmost German wine region (with Saale-Unstrut the northernmost); small parts of the Sachsen region lie in Brandenburg and Saxony-Anhalt, so the question asks for the region, not the state.
